title: She’s Gen Z. She’s an Immigrant. And She’s Going to Congress!
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Colorado's **Melat Kiros** is set to be the first Gen Z woman in Congress, and
she's looking to break the mold of establishment Democratic politics. In July,
she [won](https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2026/democratic-
socialist-melat-kiros-defeats-longtime-us-house-incumbent-in-colorado/) the
Democratic Party House primary in Denver against a sitting congresswoman who
took office before Kiros was even born; now she joins **Mehdi** to discuss her
plans after the November elections.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" We're not coming to just shake the table for the sake of shaking it. But
the table does need to be shaken,"** Kiros tells Mehdi.

Kiros, who's all but assured to win her deep blue district, discusses whether
she will be voting for minority leader Hakeem Jeffries as [House
speaker](https://zeteo.com/p/house-speaker-hakeem-jeffries-gop-resignations-
first-draft?r=3uiw9m), how democratic socialism is the tool to counter **"[
billionaires](https://zeteo.com/p/why-we-need-to-tax-billionaires-zucman-
excerpt?r=3uiw9m) that are literally developing a
[technology](https://open.substack.com/pub/zeteo/p/big-ai-wants-you-to-
believe-it-could?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web)
that is designed to replace us,"** and why she will not disown [Hasan
Piker](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-michigan-democrats-tucker-
carlson?r=3uiw9m), with whom she campaigned. **" We are holding a Twitch
streamer to a higher level of accountability than a lot of these
administration officials."**

Watch the full conversation above to hear how being fired from her job as a
corporate attorney over her opposition to the
[genocide](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-gaza-
building?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) in Gaza led to Kiros'
upset win against a 15-term incumbent democrat, plus how she defines as
democratic socialism, and the need to address gerontocracy in the U.S.
